1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses i) Mode of Tendering/Procurement:- This Tender is meant for the approved Proprietary vendor viz. M/s. GEA -BGR Energy Systems (I) Limited only and the Contract shall be awarded to the approved Proprietary bidde r or their authorized dealer only. The offers of other bidders shall not be considered for evaluation against the tender and shall be rejected. ii) Scope of the Supplier:- Supply + Supervision of Installation & Commissioning at NA LCO CPP site i.e. the ICT shall be carried out by NALCO under the Supervision of the Supplier. iii) Payment Term :- a) 80% payment shall be released to the Supplier within 10 days of CRAC. b) Balance 20% payment shall be released to the Supplier within 10 days of successf ul supervision of ICT activities at NALCO CPP site. However, the Payment of GST is subject to Reflection of the Party's Invoice in GSTR 2 A/Annex-2 (GST new return) of NALCO. iv) Delivery Period :- The delivery schedule is mentioned below:- a) The Time Period within which the material shall be delivered at NALCO CPP site:- Within 120 days b) The Time Period from the date of receipt of materials within which the call shall be given to the Supplier to send their representative to carry out Supervision of E&C acti vity :- Within 30 days b) The Time Period from the date of intimation by NALCO within which the Supplier s hall send /depute their representative to carry out the Supervision of E&C activities :- Within 15 days c) The Time Period to be taken by NALCO to carry out the Erection & Commissioning activities (i.e. accordingly, the Supplier has to send their representative for carrying

out the Supervision activities) :- Within 30 days v) LD:- The LD clause/condition shall be as per the GeM GTC. vi) CONTRACT–CUM-PERFORMANCE BANK GUARANTEE:- The seller/supplier shall furni sh a composite Contract-cum-Performance Bank Guarantee (CPBG) in NALCO’s prescribed format (enclosed along with NIT) towards su ccessful execution of the contract and for Performance Guarantee obligation of the item from any bank as approved by NALCO (Bank list enclosed belo w) for 05% (Five Percent) of the Total Basic order (contract) value including amendm ent (if any), which shall remain valid up to 60 days beyond the Warranty/Guarantee period (excluding claim period of 03 months). The seller/supplier shall furnish the CPBG within 15 days from the date of issue of PO. The bank Guarantee issued by the issuing bank on behalf of the supplier in favor of N ALCO shall be in paper form as well as under structured financial messaging system. Original Bank Guarantee issued by the issuing bank shall be sent by the issuing bank to NALCO by registered post. If the vendor fails to submit CPBG after placement of or der, the equivalent amount shall be recovered from the bill(s) of the vendor. Subject to any deduction which NALCO is authorized to make, CPBG shall be released after sa tisfactory execution of the contract and on completion of Guarantee Period as mentio ned above. On the breach of the contract by the supplier, CPBG shall be forfeited/enc ashed whether or not the company has suffered a loss on this account and Purchase Order shall be rescinded. Forfeiture/encashment of CPBG does not prejudice NALCO’s rights to make risk and c ost purchases and recover damages on account of such risk and cost purchases. NALCO to ensure availability of sufficient fund for imposition of PRS/LD/Performance i n the Contracts/PO/Orders, last stage of payment should be at least such that it cove rs the maximum liability with respect to PRS/LD/Performance. Note:- a) The acceptable modes of submission of CPBG is attached along with NIT. b) The CPBG BG Format, e-BG Format along with the List of the Banks is attached alo ng with the NIT. vii) e-BG:- The submission of BG in e-BG mode is also acceptable in addition to Paper BG. The standard beneficiary information required by the Bank for issuance of e-BG is att ached herewith (Annexure-B). However, it may please be noted that there will be no change in the text of the Bank Guarantee formats. viii) RESTRICTION UNDER RULE 144(XI) OF GFR, 2017:- The vendors are requested to go through the Rule 144(xi) of GFR 2017 and order No: 6/18/2019-PPD, dtd: 23/07/20 20 & 24/07/2020 and confirm to have complied the same. ix) The bidders are requested to furnish the declaration towards implementation of t he Integrity as per the format attached along with the NIT. x) Contact Details:- The contact details is as follows:- a) Purchase Executive:-

Mr. Hrudananda Sahoo Email: hrudananda.sahoo@nalcoindia.co.in Contact No-9437585716 b) Stores Executive (i.e. consignee):- Mr. Siba Behera Contact No-9437350693 Email: sibaprasad.behera@nalcoindia.co.in c) Technical Executive:- Mr. SANDEEP KUMAR Contact No-9437576496 Item Text:- PLC control Panels are part of the GEA-BGR COLTCS systems Delivery Text:- 1) Inspection: At our site through Functional testing. 2) Test Certificate: Required along with materials. 3) Packaging: Weather proof packaging as suitable for sophisticated electronics items capable of withstand ing rough handling during transportation. 4)Guarantee/Warranty: 18 months from the date of delivery or 12months from the date of commissioning, whichever is earlier. . 4.
